description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928, serving family-style breakfast, lunch, and dinner with a menu built around locally sourced ingredients including Canadian beef and BC chicken. The Abbotsford location on South Fraser Way is a standalone dine-in restaurant with curbside pickup and multiple delivery options. Touring cyclists will find a reliably accessible full-service meal stop with wheelchair-accessible entry on a major arterial route through the Fraser Valley.
